verdict.rationale: Nix's own docs claim reproducible development environments that transfer between computers, and state that a package working on one machine will work on another. A community member independently confirms that reproducible builds yield identical, hash-verifiable outputs. Flakes appear (`nix flake new`, `nix build`), but no evidence shows a lockfile pinning resolved dependency versions, so the specific 'install from a lockfile' mechanism is only implied. Missing for 10: documented lockfile mechanism (e.g. pinning inputs and installing from the lock), explicit docs on version pinning and resolution, hands-on corroboration of identical resolved versions across machines.
